from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal

from models import ProductModel, ProductResponse, ProductState, ProductStatus


def map_product_response_to_product_model(source: ProductResponse) -> ProductModel:
    return ProductModel(
        sku=source.sku,
        supplier_full_name=f"{source.first_name} {source.last_name}",
        price=Decimal(str(source.price_cents)) / 100,
        status=_map_product_status_to_product_state(source.status),
        active=source.status == ProductStatus.Active,
        created_at=datetime.fromtimestamp(source.created, tz=timezone.utc),
        stock=int(source.stock),
        # TODO: the source may be missing, but "discount" is required
        discount=source.discount,
    )


_PRODUCT_STATUS_TO_PRODUCT_STATE = {
    ProductStatus.Active: ProductState.ACTIVE,
    ProductStatus.Discontinued: ProductState.DISCONTINUED,
}


def _map_product_status_to_product_state(value: ProductStatus) -> ProductState:
    return _PRODUCT_STATUS_TO_PRODUCT_STATE[value]

import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.math.MathContext
import java.time.Instant

fun ProductResponse.toProductModel(): ProductModel = ProductModel(
    sku = sku,
    supplierFullName = "${firstName} ${lastName}",
    price = priceCents.toBigDecimal().divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100L), MathContext.DECIMAL128),
    status = toProductState(status),
    active = status == ProductStatus.Active,
    createdAt = Instant.ofEpochSecond(created.toLong()),
    stock = stock.toLong(),
    discount = requireNotNull(discount) { "A required value is missing in the source" },
)

private fun toProductState(value: ProductStatus): ProductState = when (value) {
    ProductStatus.Active -> ProductState.ACTIVE
    ProductStatus.Discontinued -> ProductState.DISCONTINUED
    else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Unexpected ProductStatus: $value")
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class ProductResponseMapper
{
    public static function toProductModel(ProductResponse $source): ProductModel
    {
        return new ProductModel(
            sku: $source->sku,
            supplierFullName: $source->firstName . ' ' . $source->lastName,
            price: $source->priceCents / 100,
            status: self::toProductState($source->status),
            active: $source->status === ProductStatus::Active,
            createdAt: (new \DateTimeImmutable())->setTimestamp((int) $source->created),
            stock: (int) $source->stock,
            discount: $source->discount ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.'),
        );
    }

    private static function toProductState(ProductStatus $value): ProductState
    {
        return match ($value) {
            ProductStatus::Active => ProductState::ACTIVE,
            ProductStatus::Discontinued => ProductState::DISCONTINUED,
            default => throw new \UnexpectedValueException('Unexpected ProductStatus'),
        };
    }
}

    {

            'price' => $source->priceCents / 100,
            'status' => self::toProductState($source->status),

            'created_at' => (new \DateTimeImmutable())->setTimestamp((int) $source->created),
            'stock' => (int) $source->stock,
            'discount' => $source->discount ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.'),
        ];
    }

    private static function toProductState(ProductStatus $value): string
    {
        return match ($value) {
            ProductStatus::Active => 'active',
            ProductStatus::Discontinued => 'discontinued',
            default => throw new \UnexpectedValueException('Unexpected ProductStatus'),
        };
    }
}
